subjects.profile: Rick Walker — K-8 Teacher,Former Line cook — Fruitvale

sources.name: Rick Walker
sources.quote: Honestly, I hear teachers and parents at school talking about how the city keeps promising things for Fruitvale but nothing ever moves forward. We see the same empty lots year after year, and nobody ever explains why.

sources.name: Melton Neilon
sources.quote: I’ve heard folks at the farmers market talking about the Fruitvale Transit Hub delays, but honestly, I’m not sure who’s supposed to be steering it forward. It feels like everyone’s waiting for someone else to take charge.

sources.name: Elio Perez
sources.quote: Honestly, I hear folks at the diner grumbling about how nothing ever moves forward with the Fruitvale plans, but nobody seems to know who's actually holding the reins or why it's stuck.

sources.name: Depak Ying
sources.quote: I’ve heard people talking about the Fruitvale Transit Hub delays, and it feels like no one’s stepping up to take responsibility—it’s frustrating because we need that progress.
